text:
Ava: Quick note- Spark (preview) is marked as soft-enrolled but weare seeing almost no activity. Finance flagged them as a 45d renewal risk unless we show traction. Can we coordinate a 1-hr enablement + feedback plan this week? :warning:
Priya: I can host a hands-on 45m integration + 15m Q&A. Tue/Thu morning open. Need API keys, a small sample dataset, and their expected qps.
Jenna: I emailed their tech lead for keys and an S3 role yesterday. They said legal is reviewing the DPA; might be a day delay. I asked for a dev token in the meantime.
Liam: For success metrics let's track: first successful inference, median latency, error rate by code, tokens/day, and a basic engagement score (calls per active engineer). Also propose a 3-question post-session survey: clarity, blocker severity, next steps.
Carlos: Can we add a short telemetry toggle in the SDK to include per-request latency header? That would help their SRE team immediately. Minimal risk if opt-in.
Priya: That would be very helpful. With latency + error codes we can suggest batching or quant profiles tailored to their load.
Ava: Action list: (1) Jenna ap chase DPA + dev token; (2) Priya ap draft agenda + survey; (3) Carlos ap feasibility on latency header; (4) Liam ap build a customer-specific dashboard in console to watch first-week adoption.
Jenna: Also sent them a short FAQ about data retention and on-prem options - they asked about logs retention for the preview. I added our doc link.
Priya: Draft agenda:
```
- 10m intros + SLAs
- 20m integration walkthrough: keys, code sample, common pitfalls
- 15m run a sample inference together
- 15m feedback + next steps
```
Priya: I'll make the calendar invite and include the survey link.
Liam: For the dashboard I'll pin metrics: daily active keys, median latency, error rate, tokens/day. Set an alert if tokens/day < 10 after 5 days.
Carlos: Feasibility: can add opt-in header X-RW-LATENCY in SDK responses for preview tenants by EOD tomorrow. Will open a small PR and tag the preview flag.
Ava: Great. If we have keys by EOD demain we can schedule Wed session. If keys stall, escalate to the AE. Who will triage survey responses?
Priya: I will do first-pass triage (classify as docs/integration/infra) and escalate product items to Carlos.
onboard-bot: Reminder set: "Spark preview enablement" Wed 10:00 AM - calendar invite queued.
Ava: Thanks everyone - will update the renewal-risk tag after the session if adoption looks healthy. If we don't get tokens by EOD tomorrow, Jenna escalate to AE and cc me. :rotating_light:
